newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mint tenders copper, nickel, zinc.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mint tenders copper, nickel, zinc.

text.p: The U.S. Mint on Thursday set tenders for 1,695 tonnes of copper, 250 tonnes of nickel and 2,981 tonnes of high grade zinc.

The Mint said that tenders for copper cathodes must be submitted by 1000 EST (1500 GMT) Monday, March 10. Nickel cathode or briquette tenders must be received by 1000 EST (1500 GMT) Tuesday, March 11.
It said that tenders for special high-grade zinc must be submitted by 1000 EST (1500 GMT) Wednesday, March 12.
